text:
liam_support: customer acme-ai reporting sudden 503s on /v1/embeddings since ~09:12 UTC, heavy embed bursts. They attached request ids and a fragment of logs — asking for eng triage
melissa_oncall: jumping in. can you paste the request id and sample payload? did they change batch size?
liam_support: reqids: r-5f3a2, r-5f3a3, r-5f3a9. payload was embeddings for 300 docs in one call, avg doc ~1.2k tokens. Customer says this was working yesterday.
carla_cs: they say QPS spiked after a job kick — probably a cron. Customer impact: many 503s, some retries succeeded.
sara_sre: looking at infra dashboards — correlated with GPU worker restarts on host gpu-46 at 09:11:42 UTC. watchdog logs show repeated container restarts.
melissa_oncall: can we get runner logs from that time? jordan_ml / infra-bot, any stack traces?
infra-bot: pulling logs from gcp://redwood-prod/us-east1/gpu-46 (09:10-09:15) — 12MB. snippet: ```
E0909 09:11:43.762 upstream_runner: segfault at 0x7ffd3f2a
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
GPU memory usage spike: 98% -> cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
*** Aborted at 169XXX (signal 11, SIGSEGV) ***
```
jordan_ml: looks like a SIGSEGV in the attention kernel after memory alloc failed. logs show kv-prefetch attempted to allocate a large KV buffer during toolcall embedding.
melissa_oncall: hypothesis: large batch + aggressive kv-prefetch + recent quantization kernel change causes invalid mem access under OOM. any recent rollout?
jordan_ml: we rolled quant-kernels v2.1 to the fleet at 08:55 UTC. can repro locally with a stress script. I'll try a repro.
liam_support: customer provided curl repro: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"embed-12b-quant","inputs": ["<big list of docs>"], "batch_size":300}'
```
melissa_oncall: ok mitigation: enabling fallback routing to lower-capacity but stable embed nodes for acme-ai, and temporarily disable kv-prefetch on hosted for that model. can you apply?
sara_sre: applied routing rule -> fallbacks to embed-stable-pool for customer tenant id acme-123. disabled kv-prefetch flag for model embed-12b-quant on hosted (feature flag off). monitoring.
liam_support: customer confirms immediate reduction in 503s after fallback. they still want root cause and timeline.
jordan_ml: repro steps I used: heavy-batch script (attached) + toolcall pattern -> crash reproduces in ~10s. stacktrace: ```
#0 0x7f2a1c in attention_kernel
#1 0x7f3b2d in kv_prefetch
#2 0x40f1aa in run_model
#3 0x401abc in main
```
melissa_oncall: can we roll back quant-kernels v2.1 from hosted or patch kernel to check? rollback risk?
jordan_ml: rollback is low-risk for now; I'll open a rollback and patch ticket. quick patch: add OOM guard before prefetched allocation and fall back to on-demand loading.
infra-bot: created rollback change 5421 -> rolling to 12% canary on embed nodes.
sara_sre: monitoring canary: so far 0 crashes in canary group after rollback. latency stable.
carla_cs: I told acme-ai we'll follow up in 2 hrs with RCA and ETA to fully roll. they appreciated the fallback routing. :thumbsup:
liam_support: ticket INC-2024-334 created and linked to customer's case. assigned to jordan_ml and sara_sre.
melissa_oncall: next steps: 1) keep fallback routing for acme until full fleet rollback completes 2) full rollback if canary looks good at 30m 3) build regression test for heavy-embed + kv-prefetch 4) notify customers we mitigated and will provide RCA
jordan_ml: adding repro script & stack trace to the ticket, will push rollback pr in 10m.
liam_support: thanks team. keeping this thread open; ping if any new 503 clusters pop up.
carla_cs: customer follow-up scheduled at 11:30 UTC.
melissa_oncall: closing initial alert once fleet stable, will update thread with RCA draft. :white_check_mark:
